title: A staff switch writes the chain's draft copy in seven parts instead of five
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: With sevenParts on, the draft copy starts with --parallel-pages 7 and --split-shared; off, with --parallel-pages 5.

tests: with sevenParts on, the draft copy is written in seven parts, and the split of "shared" stays
